name: Abracadabra CauldronV4 borrow-share rounding (yvCrv3Crypto and magicAPE cauldrons)
summary: CauldronV4 rounds totalBorrow elastic/base conversions so repeated tiny borrow and repay calls skew the ratio once the debt is nearly cleared. The attacker repaid every borrower and called repayForAll, looped 1-wei borrow/repay until new borrows recorded zero borrow parts, then borrowed the cauldron's MIM against dust collateral.
notes: The anchor drained the yvCurve-3Crypto cauldron clone; 12 minutes later the same attacker drained the magicAPE cauldron 0x692887e8, another clone of the same CauldronV4 master. It is campaign, not a target, because the anchor did not execute it.
Loss is DegenBox's net MIM outflow over both transactions; the collateral the attacker deposited is not subtracted.
